Aggregate sampling-unit progress to an administrative level

Source: R/admin_map.R
admin_map_data.Rd

Collapses the output of psu_map_data() to one row per administrative unit, keeping units in which no data has yet been collected.

admin_map_data(
  x,
  level = "zone",
  values = NULL,
  values_by = NULL,
  primary_only = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

Output of psu_map_data().

level

Column of x holding the administrative unit: "zone" (the default, the level the PSU maps use), or any level carried through by adm_cols in read_psu_frame() such as "adm1" or "adm2". Use "overall" for a single national row.

values

Optional data frame of indicator values to join, such as an estimate table from estimate_coverage() with by = ~zone.

values_by

Column of values holding the unit name. Guessed from the unit names when NULL.

primary_only

Count only primary sampling units in the denominator. Backup units are replacements, so including them inflates the frame.

Value

A tibble of class vcs_admin_map with one row per unit: level, name, psus_frame, psus_opened, pct_psus_opened, psus_with_children, psus_zero_children, visits, children, children_per_opened_psu, plus any joined values.

See also

plot_admin_map(), psu_map_data()

Other PSU maps: dissolve_frame_boundaries(), plot_admin_map(), plot_admin_progress_bars(), plot_psu_map(), psu_map_data(), psu_map_summary(), read_admin_boundaries(), read_psu_frame()

Examples

raw <- vcs_example_frame_raw
frame <- read_psu_frame(primary = raw[raw$psu_type == "Primary", ],
                        backup  = raw[raw$psu_type == "Backup", ])
#> Error in read_psu_frame(primary = raw[raw$psu_type == "Primary", ], backup = raw[raw$psu_type ==     "Backup", ]): could not find function "read_psu_frame"
pm <- psu_map_data(vcs_example_raw, frame, psu_var = "psu_id",
                   zone_var = "health_zone", child_marker = "EC_ID",
                   n_caregivers = 2, n_children = 2)
#> Error in psu_map_data(vcs_example_raw, frame, psu_var = "psu_id", zone_var = "health_zone",     child_marker = "EC_ID", n_caregivers = 2, n_children = 2): could not find function "psu_map_data"
admin_map_data(pm, level = "zone")
#> Error in admin_map_data(pm, level = "zone"): could not find function "admin_map_data"
admin_map_data(pm, level = "adm1")
#> Error in admin_map_data(pm, level = "adm1"): could not find function "admin_map_data"
